messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up: Stratus Insights renewal in 5 weeks. They're evaluating moving 90% of traffic from Hosted to a Dedicated pool and asked to rebaseline pricing + ask for uplift discount for the expansion.
emma_sales: Quick numbers: current ARR $210k, existing commit $70k/yr, monthly tokens ~3.1B, noted p95 latency spikes ~950ms during end-of-day batch windows. Customer asks for 12mo commit and predictable rate.
sara_cs: They also require EU data residency and a copy of our SOC2 report. CS notes they want a 10-business-day POC window to validate throughput and failover behavior.
emma_sales: Customer requested targeted blended rate $0.0098/token (list $0.0145) — sounds aggressive. They also expect dedicated support during migration.
luis_dealdesk: That's ~32% off list. We need usage roll-forward, top-5 peak hours, and a forecast showing why the uplift is locked in for 12mo. Without that, max automated approval is 18%.
emma_sales: I'll attach their last 6 months of ingestion and peak hour CSV. Also they'll give exec sponsorship if we can guarantee EU residency and a 99.95% uptime SLA for the Dedicated pool.
kevin_legal: Legal flags: SLA tweaks and residency are doable but require addendum. Any rollback or special indemnity requests will need redlines. On-prem connector or HSM changes are negotiated separately.
dan_engineering: For the POC we need model details (Stratus runs open-llm-text-3 variants), max seq 4096, KV cache reuse ~55%, target sustained throughput 1.5M tokens/min. GPU suggestion: start with an A100-backed pool for validation; if quantized on A10G meets latency we can propose that for production.
sara_cs: Migration plan constraint: customer wants cutover within 5 weeks after signing. POC week 1-2, dry-run week 3, migration week 4-5. CS can run runbook with their infra team.
luis_dealdesk: Deal desk guidance: approve up to 18% off list for a 12mo commit with our standard setup fee $10k. Anything deeper needs director approval and a one-time onboarding fee to cover POC infra.
emma_sales: Proposed customer-facing offer: 12mo commit, blended $0.0119/token, $10k setup fee, 10-business-day POC included (performance-only), EU residency addendum, standard SLA.
deploy-bot: New doc created: /sales/stratus/renewal/2001805000-usage-6mo.csv by emma_sales
dan_engineering: I'll pre-reserve the test pool and draft the POC runbook. Need contact: @stratus-devops and an allowlist IP for the test env.
kevin_legal: I'll draft the addendum for residency + SOC2 attachment. If they require data export controls beyond standard contract, flag to legal immediately.
luis_dealdesk: Conditions for approval: 1) usage CSV + peak hour data uploaded, 2) exec sponsor confirmed in writing, 3) setup fee included in quote. If all satisfied I'll sign off at 18% discount.
emma_sales: Will upload CSV and get exec note today. I'll prepare the quote with the conditional language and cc luis + kevin. ETA 18h.
sara_cs: I'll prepare the migration checklist and a rollback plan in case the Dedicated pool shows regression.
emma_sales: Thanks — leaning to accept 18% + $10k to keep the account and move them to Dedicated. If director wants to approve lower price we can escalate.
luis_dealdesk: Acknowledged. Approver: luis_dealdesk (conditional).
emma_sales: Closing loop after I upload docs. Will update thread. :rocket:
